We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Sales Lead Poland (m/f/d) Your role:

You own the Poland market on the sales side. You'll build and lead a high-performing AE & SDR team from the ground up - hiring, ramping, coaching and holding the bar on day-to-day execution.

You stay close to the front line: running deals yourself when it matters, jumping into demos and discovery calls, and setting the standard for how we sell in Poland.

You own the Polish sales number - monthly and yearly targets - and you're accountable for a reliable forecast. You work hand in hand with Marketing on lead-gen for the PL market and with Customer Success on clean handoffs.

You translate what works in DACH into the polish context, feed learnings back to the leadership team, and shape how the whole polish sales motion scales.

What's waiting for you:

 * Market ownership: Full responsibility for fonio's sales performance in Poland.

 * Team building: Hire, ramp and coach the polish AE & SDR team as we scale.

 * Player-coach: Lead from the front - stay in deals and demos, not just dashboards.

 * Quota ownership: Clear monthly and yearly targets for the PL market - you?re setting it up for the team.

 * Cross-functional impact: Close collaboration with Marketing, Customer Success and the founders.

 * Build, don't maintain: Shape the Polish sales motion in a fast-scaling startup.

What we offer:

 * €70,000 - 100,000 (base + uncapped commission; depending on experience)

 * On-site in Warsaw (with a 2-month onboarding on-site in Vienna to start)

 * Top equipment of your choice and extremely short decision paths

 * Direct line to the founders and real ownership over an entire market

What you bring:

 * Several years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a track record of closing along a clear funnel

 * First leadership or team-lead experience

 * Strong product and technology understanding

 * Polish at native level and confident, fluent English; German is a strong plus

 * Startup mindset - builder mentality

Hiring process

 * 15 min Intro call

 * 60 min Skill Interview with our CCO Alex Brix

 * 20 min Language & Team Fit

 * 20 min Culture Interview

jobs.description:
Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

We make life easier, safer and greener, with technology that achieves more, consumes less and is accessible to everyone. Microelectronics from Infineon is the key to a better future. Efficient use of energy, environmentally-friendly mobility and security in a connected world we solve some of the most critical challenges that our society faces while taking a conscientious approach to the use of natural resources. 1 Senior Staff Engineer Process Integration for Wide Bandgap Power Technologies (w/m/div) Technologies in our Manufacturing and Operations team, your contribution ensures that innovation never stands still. Together, we make reliability our strongest asset. Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Apply advanced statistical methods and AI applications to support technology stabilization, yield improvement, and cost optimization across the global process chain

 * Act as the Front-End representative for the development of WBG power technologies, collaborating closely with development and transfer teams

 * Drive and manage actions resulting from technology ramp-up activities following the official production release

 * Take full ownership of yield planning and ensure continuous yield monitoring to meet performance targets

 * Lead and participate in root cause analysis teams to define sustainable corrective and preventive actions for process deviations

 * Sustain and optimize high-volume production by contributing expert know-how on process and equipment capabilities in collaboration with global partner fabs

 * Execute release and delivery decisions for production goods in strict alignment with established quality and production standards

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

 * A Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Data Science, or a comparable technical field

 * Several years of professional experience in semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on technology development, process, or yield engineering

 * Technical expertise in Silicon or WBG technologies (SiC/GaN) and experience supporting technology ramp-ups in high-volume environments

 * Advanced skills in statistical data analysis (SPC, DOE) and the application of AI/Machine Learning for process optimization

 * A structured and analytical mindset with a proven ability to drive complex topics independently from analysis to implementation

 * Excellent communication and interface skills to collaborate effectively across global production, quality, and development teams

 * Fluency in English is required, with German language skills being a distinct advantage in our international environment

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.

Apply to this position online by following the URL and entering the Job ID in our job search.
